title: DEEPPERSONA: A Generative Engine for Scaling Deep Synthetic Personas

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the distribution of simulated responses on the World Values Survey and Big Five Personality Test against real human survey data across six diverse countries (including well-represented and under-represented cultures) using statistical distance metrics like the Kolmogorov-Smirnov (KS) statistic, Wasserstein distance, and Jensen-Shannon divergence.

Evaluating the uniqueness, attribute coverage, and depth of the generated personas using an LLM-as-a-judge to ensure the profiles mitigate majority-culture defaults and avoid homogenized, generic, or stereotypical human representations.
